## In Snow

---


[__Entity Condition Type__](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/types/entity_condition_types/in_snow)

Checks if it's snowing at the entity's position.

Type ID: `eggolib:in_snow`

---

### Examples

=== "Example #1"

    ```json
    "condition": {
        "type": "eggolib:in_snow"
    }
    ```
